title: Stepan Kolesnikoff's Gouache Landscapes
content: Stepan Kolesnikoff(Russian / Ukrainian / Serbian,1879-1955) painted landscapes in oil, but he also worked in gouache.Fishing in March,gouache on card,4 1/2 x 6 1/8 in. (11.6 x 15.5 cm.), sometimes rather small.Slush. 1917 gouache on cardboard. 53 × 67 cm. (21 x 26in.)Sometimes they were larger, like this study of a wagon on a slushy road.
